name: Plaza de Coco Chicken Tortilla Soup (Strained Mod)
whyItWorks: Savory chicken broth and shredded chicken are soothing, but the standard bowl includes whole corn kernels, black bean skins, and crispy corn tortilla strips.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Only order on a good day and ask for NO crispy corn tortilla strips, corn, or black beans (or sip the savory broth and shredded chicken while leaving the corn and beans behind).
watchOuts: Whole corn kernels and black bean skins
Mild chili heat in the tomato-chicken broth
